name: East Common Play Area
description: Play area for children up to 12 on the common between Chequer Lane, East Common and West Common, with a large metal slide, log climbing and scramble nets, a zip wire, monkey bars and a balance trail, a wooden play boat, a toddler multi-play unit, cradle and junior swings, and an accessible swing.
